description: Evaluation questions for keyword, semantic and hybrid FAQ retrieval and for the answer decision, against data/faqs.json. eval_001-eval_050 are the Stage 3 cases from data/semantic_search_eval.json with unchanged queries and expected IDs. Labels were written before running any evaluation and must not be changed to improve scores. expected_faq_ids lists every acceptable FAQ (empty = out of scope). expected_decision is answered (any acceptable FAQ), ambiguous (a clarifying question is expected) or no_match. category is the expected FAQs' category (null when they span several or for out-of-scope questions); category_filter, when set, is sent as the request's category.
